nodes.summary: The joint probability of class `c` (`true` = damaging) and feature values `x`: `π ∏ P_D(x_j)` or `(1 - π) ∏ P_B(x_j)`.
nodes.title: Joint probability of class and features in naive Bayes

nodes.summary: The log-likelihood ratio `log (P_D(v) / P_B(v))` of value `v` of feature `j`.
nodes.title: Log-likelihood ratio of a feature value

nodes.summary: A two-class naive Bayes model: class *damaging* has prior `prior ∈ (0, 1)`, class *benign* the complement; each feature `j` takes values in the finite type `X j` with class-conditional probabilities `damaging j` and `benign j`, assumed positive; features are conditionally independent given the class. The tables are estimated from training data.
nodes.title: Two-class naive Bayes model

nodes.summary: The posterior probability of *damaging* is the logistic function of the score.
nodes.title: Naive-Bayes posterior

nodes.summary: The posterior is strictly monotone in the score.
nodes.title: Naive Bayes posterior is strictly monotone in the score

nodes.summary: Let feature `j` carry a numerical value `g v` (for example a PSIC-difference bin) such that its likelihood ratio `P_D(v) / P_B(v)` is monotone in `g v`. With the other features fixed, the posterior is monotone in `g`.
nodes.title: Monotonicity in a feature value

nodes.summary: The posterior probability that the variant is damaging given feature values `x` (Bayes' rule on the joint law).
nodes.title: Naive Bayes posterior probability of damage

nodes.summary: The profile log-odds score `log (p a / q a)` of residue `a`: `p` is the position-specific profile probability (estimated from aligned homologs), `q` the background probability. Meaningful for `p a, q a > 0`; otherwise Lean's `log 0 = 0` and `x / 0 = 0` give junk.
nodes.title: Profile log-odds score of a residue

nodes.summary: The PSIC difference is the log of the ratio of the two residues' likelihood ratios.
nodes.title: PSIC difference as a log ratio of likelihood ratios

nodes.summary: The PSIC difference is positive iff the wild type is more enriched in the profile, relative to background, than the mutant.
nodes.title: Positivity criterion for the PSIC difference

nodes.summary: The PSIC score difference of a substitution from the wild-type residue `wt` to the mutant residue `mt`: `profileScore p q wt - profileScore p q mt`.
nodes.title: PSIC score difference of a substitution

nodes.summary: The naive-Bayes score: prior log-odds plus the features' log-likelihood ratios.
nodes.title: Naive Bayes score

nodes.summary: The joint law of class and features is a probability law.
nodes.title: Naive Bayes joint law is a probability law

nodes.summary: If `p` and `q` are probability vectors and `q` is positive, the expected score under the profile, `∑ p a log (p a / q a)` (the Kullback–Leibler divergence), is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Gibbs' inequality for the profile score

nodes.summary: If `p` and `q` are probability vectors and `p` is positive, the expected score under the background, `∑ q a log (p a / q a)`, is nonpositive.
nodes.title: Expected profile score under the background is nonpositive

nodes.summary: For a sequence `s` over independent positions with profiles `p j` and background `q` (all positive), the summed profile score is the log of the likelihood ratio `∏ p_j(s_j) / ∏ q(s_j)` of the profile model against the background.
nodes.title: The score is a log-likelihood ratio

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
